Synthetic Oat Crumble Bars

By Robin Invented

Invented bars with a crumbly top & a soft middle.

Synthetic 30 minutes Makes 16 bars

Ingredients

  • 2 cups rolled oats
  • 1 cup flour
  • 1/2 cup butter, melted
  • 1/3 cup brown sugar
  • 1 pinch salt (to taste)

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 350°F and line a pan.
  2. Mix the oats, flour, sugar and salt; stir in the butter.
  3. Press into the pan and bake for 30 minutes.
Cool before cutting into 16 bars.
